caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a container resembling a small, decorative casket or box, centered on a plain, off-white background. The container is shaped with a slightly flared, rounded base and a domed, hinged lid. The sides of the box feature alternating light brown, dark brown, and beige mottled or marbled panels bordered by metallic bands, likely intended to represent brass or gold, with evenly spaced rivets. The lid is covered in a reddish-brown or burgundy material and is reinforced with metallic straps that meet at a circular decorative piece topped with a looped handle at the center. There is no visible opening, but the hinged construction is suggested by the drawing. The composition is minimalist, with the object rendered in fine detail and occupying the center of the otherwise blank page. At the bottom right, the name "Carl Buergerriss." is handwritten in blue ink, and at the upper right corner, there is a small notation "No 74."
title: Box for Small Jewelry
